svg.title: Stump of Life: circular DNA alignment
svg.desc: Compressed variable mode: only informative variable columns among the selected rows are spaced equally. Original genomic and alignment distances are not preserved. Reference 'KF540505.1' is the innermost ring. Coloured A/C/G/T ticks are called substitutions; crosses are deletions; diamonds are insertions; grey ticks are unknown comparisons, not mutations. Matching called bases follow the ring baseline. This is a presentation SVG, not CAD.
